cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: More Official Than You
cards.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your picnic rota is useful. Mine has committee approval.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine got everyone to bring sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use yours for handing out sandwiches. Mine establishes who was entitled to request them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then approve mine. We've already started eating.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Staple yours behind mine as Appendix A, and keep lunch moving.

reason: Keep the strong appendix bargain, add actual use of B functioning plan and remove the explanation that lunch has a legitimate basis.
